changelog:
- Start with Windows now opens the normal window and welcome animation.
- Fixed a dark or black startup view by starting initialization after the first content render.
- Silenced notifications and stopped queued audio, balloons, and window restores during Windows shutdown, restart, logoff, and manual exit.
- Removed the gray branch-list background during project loading while keeping branch controls disabled until Git operations finish.
- Updated startup descriptions in all six interface languages.
